title: With the Fire on High
author: Elizabeth Acevedo
summary: Emoni Santiago, a teenage mother in Philadelphia, has a rare gift for cooking. As senior year goes on, she balances caring for her daughter and grandmother with her dream of becoming a chef.
readIf: you like warm, food-filled coming-of-age stories about family and following a passion.
skipIf: you want high drama or a fast plot, as this is a gentle, character-focused book.
